structs.notes: Size 688 is proven: the derived class (BgVehiclePhysicsGround::Setup) writes its own wheel array starting at base+688. Member offsets above come from raw Replay accesses in LoadFromMemFile/SaveToMemFile/the constructor; widths are from the same functions. The packet's anchor list agrees with all of them except the m_vehicleType width. The IDA layout on disk (1960 bytes, placeholders 'm_obj...'/'_pad...') should not be used as the base: the coordinator must move the members at 688 and above to the derived structs (BgVehiclePhysicsGround starts at 688).
